newsitem.title: UK: Swiss pay most for property insurance-Euro survey.
newsitem.headline: Swiss pay most for property insurance-Euro survey.

text.p: Property insurance prices in Europe are highest in Switzerland, with the UK the second most expensive, UK based management consultancy Datamonitor said on Monday.
Some 120 million property insurance policies are sold in Europe each year at an average price of $285. The Swiss pay an average of $555 and the British $492.

"The high price of insurance policies in Switzerland and its low claims ratio make it one of the most profitable markets in Europe," Datamonitor said in its report 'European Property and Casualty Insurance.'
The report also showed that property insurance prices are rising fastest in Greece, followed by Ireland and Spain.
Policy sales in most countries are 300 to 450 per 1,000 inhabitants, with the fastest growth rates in Portugal, Spain and Germany.
